shots.shows: Column of troops crossing a beach from a beached landing craft; smoke drifting.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10782 shot list #3-4: 'LCU and other equipment up to beach; troops' / 'Column of troops going down beach', following #2 'LCI, beaching at Normandy'. Record dates the reel to June 1944 (month only); the shot is NOT claimed to be 6 June or a named beach.

shots.narration: The largest seaborne invasion in history began.
shots.shows: Landing craft flying the U.S. flag under way toward the beach, many ships behind.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10770 #3 'CU LCM coming up toward beach'; reel titled 'Invasion of Europe (Normandy)', June 1944.

shots.narration: Thousands of men would never come home.
shots.shows: Soldier on a shingle beach littered with debris and wrecked craft.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10785 #22 'CU Army sargeant walking guard on beach; lot of debris in background'. The man shown is not claimed to be a casualty.

shots.shows: Soldiers in helmets and life belts lined up on a quay.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10769 #7 'Soldiers in ranks waiting to board landing craft'; subject heading 'England'; title 'Invasion of Europe'.

shots.narration: crowded aboard landing craft, bound for Nazi-occupied France.
shots.shows: Harbor packed with landing craft full of troops.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10769 #3-6 'LCMs and LCVPs tied up to docking area in British town' / 'Soldiers boarding LCVPs'.

shots.shows: Column of landing craft at sea under barrage balloons.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10742 #4-6 'British LCTs underway at sea' / 'Column of British LCTs'; reel 'Invasion of Europe (Normandy)'.

shots.narration: Thousands of ships and landing craft crossed the English Channel.
shots.shows: Landing craft under way at sea; barrage balloons overhead.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10742 #6-7 'Column of British LCTs; American flag flying in left foreground' / 'Patrol craft passing'.

shots.shows: Battleship firing; landing craft passing in foreground.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10785 #1 'LS Battleship bombarding beach; LCM passing in foreground'.

shots.narration: battleships opened fire on the German defenses.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10785 #2 'USS Texas (BB-35) fires a salvo' (ship not named on screen: frame-to-shot mapping not verified).

shots.narration: Landing craft ran onto the beaches,
shots.shows: Normandy beach: beached landing craft, ships offshore, men walking on the sand.

shots.narration: and men stepped down onto the sand.
shots.shows: From the deck of the LCI: men moving down the ramps onto the beach in faint light.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10782 #2 'side ramps are dropped on LCI and men are seen moving down ramps and onto beach area', 'faint morning light'.

shots.shows: Wounded man lying under a blanket on a landing craft; face visible, no injuries visible.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10782 #30 'HA MS Looking down over a wounded man, lying on deck, covered over with a blanket; only his face is seen.'

shots.shows: Wrecked landing craft on the beach.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10785 #20-23 'LCVP broken in two; LCT beached' / 'Wrecked landing craft'.

shots.narration: The wounded were carried back out to the ships.
shots.shows: Wounded man under a blanket being transferred from a landing craft to a ship in rough sea. No injuries visible.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10782 #31-36 'preparing to lift another wounded man from landing craft' / 'Wounded man on a stretcher'. Graphic shots #37-38 (after 390s) are excluded; the window ends at 385s.

shots.shows: Amphibious tractor (LVT) on the shingle beach; tank and barrage balloon behind.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10770 #2 'MLS LVT underway on Normandy beach; tank in background'.

shots.narration: More ships poured men and supplies
shots.shows: Tank landing ship (LST) on the beach unloading vehicles.
Steel pierheads of an artificial harbor off the coast.

shots.narration: The liberation of Western Europe had begun.
shots.shows: U.S. flag over Coast Guard craft in the crowded Normandy anchorage.
shots.record_support: 428-NPC-10770 #25-32 Coast Guard patrol boats among sunken ships off Normandy.
